facts.fact: Verdade, quoting the customs team manager, reports the electronic single window (JUE) in force at southern customs posts from 1 September 2012 and already used at the ports of Maputo and Beira and Tete customs, with clearance in one day against over 72 hours before.

Verdade reports the JUE as a single platform to which information is sent and from which customs and other parties in clearance take data, mandatory from 15 September 2012 at Centre and North customs posts.
